def test_project_state_defaults():
    st = ProjectState()
    assert st.image_path is None
    assert st.prompt is None
    assert st.polygon_px == []
    assert st.reference == "height"
    assert st.height_mm == 200.0
    assert st.material_id == "acrylic-3"
    assert st.base_id == "oval-wood"
    assert st.kerf_mode == "app"
    assert st.input_kind == "mockup"
    assert st.edge_inset_mm == {"mockup": 0.5, "photo": 0.8}
    assert st.simplify_tol_mm == 0.03
    assert st.template_path is None

def test_project_state_validations_enums():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        ProjectState(reference="diagonal")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        ProjectState(kerf_mode="invalid_kerf")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        ProjectState(input_kind="sketch")

        ProjectState(height_mm=0.0)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):

def test_project_dict_roundtrip_basic():
    st = ProjectState(
        reference="width",
        height_mm=180.0,
        material_id="acrylic-5",
        base_id=None,
        kerf_mode="lightburn",
        input_kind="photo",
        simplify_tol_mm=0.05,
    )
    d = project_to_dict(st)
    assert d["reference"] == "width"
    assert d["height_mm"] == pytest.approx(180.0)
    assert d["base_id"] is None
    assert d["schema"] == SCHEMA_VERSION

    restored = project_from_dict(d)
    assert restored.reference == st.reference
    assert restored.height_mm == pytest.approx(st.height_mm)
    assert restored.material_id == st.material_id
    assert restored.base_id is None
    assert restored.kerf_mode == st.kerf_mode
    assert restored.input_kind == st.input_kind

def test_project_dict_roundtrip_with_prompt_and_polygon():
    p = Prompt(points=((10, 20), (30, 40)), labels=(1, 0), box=(5, 5, 50, 50))
    poly_pts = [(0, 0), (100, 0), (100, 100), (0, 100)]
    st = ProjectState(
        prompt=p,
        polygon_px=poly_pts,
        template_path=pathlib.Path("/tmp/some_tpl.lamptpl"),
    )
    d = project_to_dict(st)
    restored = project_from_dict(d)

    assert restored.prompt is not None
    assert restored.prompt.points == p.points
    assert restored.prompt.labels == p.labels
    assert restored.prompt.box == p.box
    assert restored.polygon_px == poly_pts
    assert str(restored.template_path) == str(st.template_path)

def test_project_relative_vs_absolute_paths(tmp_path):
    proj_dir = tmp_path / "my_project"
    proj_dir.mkdir()
    inside_img = proj_dir / "design.png"
    inside_img.write_text("fake_inside", encoding="utf-8")

    outside_img = tmp_path / "external.png"
    outside_img.write_text("fake_outside", encoding="utf-8")

    # Inside project folder -> relative in dict
    st_inside = ProjectState(image_path=inside_img)
    d_inside = project_to_dict(st_inside, base_dir=proj_dir)
    assert not pathlib.Path(d_inside["image_path"]).is_absolute()
    restored_inside = project_from_dict(d_inside, base_dir=proj_dir)
    assert restored_inside.image_path.resolve() == inside_img.resolve()

    # Outside project folder -> absolute in dict
    st_outside = ProjectState(image_path=outside_img)
    d_outside = project_to_dict(st_outside, base_dir=proj_dir)
    assert pathlib.Path(d_outside["image_path"]).is_absolute()
    restored_outside = project_from_dict(d_outside, base_dir=proj_dir)
    assert restored_outside.image_path.resolve() == outside_img.resolve()

def test_project_save_load_roundtrip(tmp_path):
    proj_file = tmp_path / "test_proj.lampproj"
    st = ProjectState(
        reference="height",
        height_mm=250.0,
        material_id="acrylic-3",
        base_id="oval-wood",
        kerf_mode="app",
        prompt=Prompt(points=((15, 25),), labels=(1,)),
    )
    saved_path = save_project(st, proj_file)
    assert saved_path == proj_file
    assert proj_file.exists()

    loaded = load_project(proj_file)
    assert loaded.height_mm == pytest.approx(250.0)
    assert loaded.material_id == "acrylic-3"
    assert loaded.prompt is not None
    assert loaded.prompt.points == ((15, 25),)

def test_project_schema_validation(tmp_path):
    proj_file = tmp_path / "bad_schema.lampproj"
    st = ProjectState()
    save_project(st, proj_file)

    data = json.loads(proj_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    data["schema"] = 99
    proj_file.write_text(json.dumps(data), encoding="utf-8")

    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        load_project(proj_file)

def test_reproducibility_run_pipeline_identical_sha256(tmp_path):
    img_path = pathlib.Path("tests/data/ploca.png")
    mask_path = pathlib.Path("tests/data/ref/ploca.png")
    if not img_path.exists() or not mask_path.exists():
        img_path = tmp_path / "syn_ploca.png"
        mask_path = tmp_path / "syn_mask.png"
        Image.new("RGB", (400, 400), (20, 20, 20)).save(img_path)
        m = np.zeros((400, 400), dtype=np.uint8)
        m[100:300, 100:300] = 255
        Image.fromarray(m).save(mask_path)

    cfg = Config()
    mat = MaterialProfile(id="acrylic-3", name="Akril 3mm", thickness_mm=3.0, kerf_mm=0.18)
    base = BaseProfile(id="oval-wood", name="Ovalna", slot_length_mm=80.0, slot_thickness_mm=3.4, tab_width_mm=78.0, tab_height_mm=8.0)

    out1 = tmp_path / "out1"
    out2 = tmp_path / "out2"

    res1 = run_pipeline(img_path, mask_file=mask_path, height_mm=100.0, material=mat, base=base, config=cfg, out_dir=out1)
    res2 = run_pipeline(img_path, mask_file=mask_path, height_mm=100.0, material=mat, base=base, config=cfg, out_dir=out2)

    assert res1.svg_path.exists()
    assert res2.svg_path.exists()
    hash1 = io_utils.file_sha256(res1.svg_path)
    hash2 = io_utils.file_sha256(res2.svg_path)
    assert hash1 == hash2

def test_geometry_kerf_affects_cut_geometry_bounds():
    poly = box(0.0, 0.0, 100.0, 100.0)
    mat_small = MaterialProfile(id="m_sm", name="Small Kerf", thickness_mm=3.0, kerf_mm=0.1)
    mat_large = MaterialProfile(id="m_lg", name="Large Kerf", thickness_mm=3.0, kerf_mm=0.3)

    geom_sm = geometry.compute_cut_geometry(poly, mat_small, kerf_mode="app")
    geom_lg = geometry.compute_cut_geometry(poly, mat_large, kerf_mode="app")

    b_sm = geom_sm.cut_path.bounds
    b_lg = geom_lg.cut_path.bounds
    # Kerf 0.3 expands path more than kerf 0.1
    w_sm = b_sm[2] - b_sm[0]
    h_sm = b_sm[3] - b_sm[1]
    w_lg = b_lg[2] - b_lg[0]
    h_lg = b_lg[3] - b_lg[1]
    assert w_lg > w_sm
    assert h_lg > h_sm

def test_geometry_kerf_lightburn_mode_bounds_unchanged():
    poly = box(0.0, 0.0, 100.0, 100.0)
    mat_small = MaterialProfile(id="m_sm", name="Small Kerf", thickness_mm=3.0, kerf_mm=0.1)
    mat_large = MaterialProfile(id="m_lg", name="Large Kerf", thickness_mm=3.0, kerf_mm=0.3)

    geom_sm = geometry.compute_cut_geometry(poly, mat_small, kerf_mode="lightburn")
    geom_lg = geometry.compute_cut_geometry(poly, mat_large, kerf_mode="lightburn")

    assert geom_sm.cut_path.bounds == pytest.approx(geom_lg.cut_path.bounds, abs=1e-6)
    assert geom_sm.cut_path.bounds == pytest.approx(poly.bounds, abs=1e-6)

def test_main_window_load_template_file(qapp, tmp_path):

    cut_geom = geometry.compute_cut_geometry(poly, mat, kerf_mode="app")
    scale_info = ScaleInfo(mm_per_px=0.1, reference="height", reference_mm=100.0, bbox_px=(0, 0, 1000, 1000))
    s1 = PhotoSlot(id="s1", polygon_mm=box(10.0, 10.0, 30.0, 30.0), source="manual")
    tpl = LampTemplate(outline=cut_geom, slots=[s1], decor=[], base=base, material=mat, scale=scale_info, input_kind="mockup")

    tpl_path = tmp_path / "test_template.lamptpl"
    slots.save_template(tpl, tpl_path)

    win._load_template_file(tpl_path)
    assert win.template is not None
    assert win.template_path == tpl_path
    assert len(win.template.slots) == 1

def test_main_window_load_template_invalid_file_does_not_crash(qapp, tmp_path):
    win = MainWindow()
    bad_tpl = tmp_path / "corrupt.lamptpl"
    bad_tpl.write_text('{"schema": 999, "outline": {}}', encoding="utf-8")
